summary: Polar Power filed an 8-K disclosing a common stock purchase agreement with Roth Principal Investments, allowing the company to sell up to $25 million of newly issued shares at its discretion over 36 months. No shares are sold upfront; purchases depend on conditions including an effective resale registration statement and a floor price. This equity line provides flexible capital access, functioning as a delayed equity offering. Watch for future drawdowns and potential dilution; risk-arb angle is limited as this is not a traditional acquisition.
